events.title: Cammy RIP
events.description: The community received word that long-time member Cammy had passed away. A memorial thread was opened for members to share final farewells and remembrances.

events.title: Awards
events.description: King Decade awarded to SIM-2998667, HackOnTheGo, Lives, Dax, Paran0ia, Prawnster, and reroveD. Flip Reaper awarded to aethi.

events.title: $150 Crypto Giveaway - 6 Winners
events.description: Cyber Products is running the year's biggest crypto giveaway so far with six winners receiving $25 each. Multiple entries allowed; winners drawn January 25, 2026.

events.title: $400 Post-to-Win Rolling Jackpot
events.description: jcole is hosting a post-count-driven jackpot — every post counts toward the giveaway with one post equalling $1. Ends January 30.

events.title: New Year HackForums Contest - $400 Prize Pool
events.description: Oh_Well is hosting a Quantum-related contest with two winners taking $400 or the rare Blazing Ember award (only 5 holders total). Ends January 31.

events.title: Blessed With A Baby Boy - Thank You HF Family
events.description: eXceptional shared the joyful news of welcoming a new baby boy, reflecting on family, health, and gratitude — a quiet but powerful reminder that behind every username is a real person living real milestones.

events.title: ICE agent shot a woman in the face
events.description: The Joker opened a charged discussion around a fatal shooting involving a U.S. ICE agent in Minneapolis, with conflicting accounts, eyewitness footage, and demands for accountability.

events.title: Iran? US? Venezuela? War? = Crypto hike?
events.description: Honey Singh kicked off a debate about whether geopolitical conflict is making Bitcoin a hedge against instability again, fueled by Trump's pro-BTC stance and a 'doomsday plane' sighting.

events.title: AI Songs are on Billboard Charts
events.description: JoshAllen highlighted how repetitive but commercially successful AI-generated music is breaking onto Billboard charts, raising questions about creativity, authenticity, and the future of human artists.

events.title: 5th Earthling award goes to 7
events.description: Hackers showcased 7 donating over $500 to scam victims with no obligation, earning a second Earthling award — a reminder that HF groups can represent real integrity and action.
